terminal_name: Antwerp LNG Terminal (gem.wiki page, no CSV row)
issue: Discovery SOP 4.0b: enumerated gem.wiki Belgium LNG-terminal pages (site search + category listing). Found exactly one gem.wiki page not matched to a CSV row: 'Antwerp LNG Terminal' (gem.wiki/Antwerp_LNG_Terminal, categorized 'Proposed LNG terminals in Belgium', Owner: Fluxys, Location: Lilo/Lillo, Port of Antwerp, coordinates 51.301380, 4.333896, Status: Proposed, Type: Import, capacity/start-year blank). The page's own Background text and cross-checked independent sources (Port Technology International 2020 'New LNG facility to be built at Port of Antwerp'; offshore-energy.biz and ship-technology.com coverage of Fluxys' Quay 526/528 installation; Fluxys' own LNG-bunkering pages) all describe the SAME thing: Fluxys' permanent LNG bunkering facility at Lillo/Quay 526-528 (truck-to-ship + the FlexFueler002 bunkering pontoon, commissioned ~2020-2021) that supplies alternative marine/inland-waterway fuel -- not a marine cargo import terminal. Applied the scope gate (CLAUDE.md: 'Antwerp and the broader Belgian port complex have heavy small-scale/bunkering LNG activity... out of scope'; SOP 3: bunkering is out of scope regardless of concreteness): this fails the scope gate (bunkering-only, no cross-border marine LNG cargo import) and was NOT staged as a new_terminal, resolving scope before staging per the hard rule.
suggested_action: No database action from this batch (gem.wiki is detector-only, never a citation, and this candidate correctly fails the scope gate). Worth flagging to GEM staff separately that the gem.wiki page itself mis-frames a bunkering facility as a 'Proposed LNG import terminal' -- that is a wiki-content question, not a tracker-data gap, and is outside this batch's edit authority.
